metric.name: bottom_minus_middle_side_background_brightness
metric.description: After dominant bright tile-face normalization, take the median grayscale value from left/right side-background pixels in y=82-100% and subtract the corresponding median from y=35-55%.

paired_normalization_probe.comparison: same concealed truth at 40s vs 46s; 13 tiles; revealed same-match diagnostic only

shadow_glyph_mask_definition.component_filter: drop area<8, width>=80% of working width, height>=50% of working height
shadow_glyph_mask_definition.final_feature: surviving glyph bounding box aspect-fit to 48x72 binary canvas

paired_normalization_probe.interpretation: The bottom shadow band is a material appearance nuisance. A glyph-focused representation is substantially more invariant than plain grayscale or simple vertical trimming on this revealed same-match pair, but 12/13 is still not full-template-bank or independent-match evidence.

decision: Prefer shadow_glyph_mask_feature over simple vertical trim as the next shadow-specific classifier candidate. Do not wire either candidate or the -50 appearance threshold into Runtime yet. Keep the production identity threshold at 0.82 unchanged.
next_step: Run a parallel glyph-mask identity bank against the full tracked ordinary template set on the exact private 46s crops, and separately measure glyph-mask class separability on tracked reviewed crops. Candidate scores are not calibrated Runtime confidence. Require a separate original-match whole-hand validation before promotion.
